name: Glass Chess Auth & Donation Message Update
notes: Google sign-in readiness checks now require Firebase web app authentication values and no longer block sign-in when Storage bucket setup is deferred
Google sign-in shows specific Firebase setup and OAuth/domain error guidance
Donate opens a message and suggested-amount dialog with a separate Cash App payment link
Donation notes are preconfigured to use the connected EmailJS Gmail service and donation template
Download PNG and Copy PNG are repositioned clear of the floating Glass Hub Tools orb
Guests can continue playing without a Google account and local saves remain available
